name: Exponential Learning
description: Synthetic experiment runner simulating exponential learning curves based on psychological research modeling performance acquisition over trials.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Number of permissible stimulus values for the independent variables.

parameters.name: minimum_trial
parameters.description: Lower bound for the trial number (exponential constant).

parameters.name: minimum_initial_value
parameters.description: Lower threshold for the initial performance value.

parameters.name: maximum_initial_value
parameters.description: Upper threshold for the initial performance value.

parameters.name: lr
parameters.description: Learning rate coefficient for the exponential learning curve.

parameters.name: p_asymptotic
parameters.description: Asymptotic performance level (constant offset applied to multiplier).

parameters.name: added_noise
parameters.description: Amount of noise added to the performance observations.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame with trial and asymptotic performance conditions.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: DataFrame with performance observations over trials.
